status: complete terminal-error receiver source submilestone; M4.2-M4.6 incomplete
scope: Complete actual m4_collect_failure extraction: seven local allocations, initialized descriptor and read prefix, exact nine-byte bounded read loop with retries/errors/loss, ignored close result, all setup/wait branches, actual result constructor, two typed copies and seven local frees.
input: Aligned nonwrapping writable 144-byte caller output, writable TLS, actual initialized run/UID globals in blocks distinct from TLS; arbitrary 32-bit descriptor, bad, entered, leader-done and raw wait-status words. Output may overlap old globals or TLS. No prepared source path, selected result or successful read is assumed.
result: Every finite execution preserves old memory outside caller output and TLS and observes at most nine read bytes, including partial-read loss. Every live prefix has ordinary enabled progress or an exact return. Every actual return classifies its own read trace and source stop reason/effective bad flag, executes the actual copies and frees all seven locals. An actual SETUP output implies exactly eight read bytes, initial bad and entered zero, unsigned stage 1..8 and error 1..4095.
nonvacuity: Allocated owned inputs for arbitrary run/UID; complete actual runs for every owned input and every byte list of length at most nine, arbitrary finite waits and EINTR prefixes, every close reply, non-EINTR errors after any shorter prefix, and partial transfer loss. Complete setup/short/ninth-byte/exit/signal/stopped/raw-status witnesses include ignored close failure and raw status 65 returning SIGNALLED/detail 65.
wait_status_boundary: Wrapper wait status is an arbitrary machine word. Raw 65 produces SIGNALLED/detail 65 in the actual source, outside the intended finish SIGNALLED domain 1..64. Linux wait-status provenance and the upstream range connection remain open.
trace_boundary: The universal completed-result theorem uses the actual read trace and actual source stop reason. It does not separately identify every retry/error event by a universal abstract trace refinement. Constructive retry/error/close witnesses expose their actual event segments.
observation_boundary: Local source/effect semantics only. Read/close waits, retry/error TLS writes, asynchronous loss and partial-read memory effects remain. A close result is discarded and does not certify cleanup. Typed structure copies are single Clight steps. Finite-run existence and enabled progress do not prove termination, fairness or Linux initialization.
printing_context: The previous 48-module, 91-module and 154-module query contexts remain frozen for preceding full statements; new records use the complete 197-module context.
tool_profile: Unchanged pinned CompCert commit 14d616046360a0b2611ebdfc2f98368af402e1f7 (VERSION 3.17), Coq 8.18.0 and OCaml 4.14.1. Source/frontend/extraction correctness remains trusted; no compiler preservation theorem applied to the extended machine.
audit_allowance: Connection wrapper limit increases from 600 to 900 seconds for 197 modules. M4.1 remains 300 seconds, individual prover/coqchk bounds remain 180 seconds, and all full compilation/type/foundation/artifact/tamper checks remain enabled.
deployment: No native, kernel, VM, runtime or hardware profile changed; preserved VM artifacts only.
